confidence_notes: Restaurant, cappuccino, and beer anchors use Numbeo Helsinki prices last updated 15 October 2026. The cocktail reference is based on only seven reports, and the wine-glass figure is the midpoint of a published local range. Accommodation values are holistic estimates and are especially sensitive to season and availability.
comparable_city_reasoning: Accommodation estimates reflect Helsinki as a high-cost Nordic capital, with Stockholm and Oslo as broad regional comparables; no live accommodation prices were checked.
